Eine Haustür, die live aufgeht, ein Gara: A front door that opens live, a garage door that moves along – today the doors go into our traced floor plan.
Jede Art, jeder Stil, jedes Feld – und w: Every kind, every style, every field – and how to connect them to the contacts in Home Assistant.
Wir machen da weiter, wo Teil 1 aufgehör: We pick up where part 1 left off: the plan lies underneath, rooms and walls are traced.
Die Räume sind schon mit ihren Bereichen: The rooms are already linked to their Home Assistant areas, like in episode 1. That's how NeonPlan finds the door contacts by itself.
Rechts läuft „3D daneben“ mit – so siehs: On the right, “3D beside” – „3D daneben“ – runs along, so you see every change right away. The windows come in part 3.
Oben auf „Tür & Fenster“. Unten steht de: Click “Doors & windows” at the top – „Tür & Fenster“. The hint at the bottom says: tap a wall – you pick the kind afterwards on the right.
Ich tippe auf die Außenwand am Ende vom: I tap the outer wall at the end of the hallway, right where the plan shows the front door.
In einer Außenwand wird eine Tür von sel: In an exterior wall a door automatically becomes a front door: under “Style”, „Stil“, it says “Automatic (front door)”.
Oben wählst du die Art: Tür, Haustür, Do: At the top you pick the kind: door, front door, double door, window, terrace door, garage door and glass wall – each with fitting sizes.
Darunter „Breite“, „Mitte ab Ecke“ – als: Below that: “Width”, “Centre from corner” – where it sits in the wall – and “Height”. According to the plan: one metre wide and 2.10 high.
Verschieben geht auch im Plan: die Tür a: You can also move it in the plan: drag the door along the wall. The arrow keys move it along the wall as well.
„Anschlag wechseln“ setzt die Scharniere: “Swap hinge side”, „Anschlag wechseln“, puts the hinges on the other side; “Reverse opening direction”, „Öffnungsrichtung umdrehen“, makes the door open outwards.
Das Feld „Anschlag“ zeigt die Seite der: The “Hinge” field shows the hinge side – always seen from the room the door belongs to. At the top it says “Back to Flur”.
Ganz unten der „Kontakt“: „Automatisch (: At the very bottom is the “Contact”: “Automatic (Haustür)”. NeonPlan found the door contact in the hallway area.
Geht die Haustür in Home Assistant auf,: When the front door opens in Home Assistant, it swings open in 3D too. In the demo I switch the contact by hand.
Für Haustüren gibt es eigene Stile: mit: Front doors have their own styles: with a glass panel, with one sidelight or with two.
Beim Seitenteil stellst du darunter sein: With a sidelight you set its width below – empty means automatic. The checkbox puts it on the hinge side.
Mit zwei Seitenteilen gibt es links und: With two sidelights there's a field for left and right. I go for the front door with a glass panel – like in the plan.
Jetzt die Badtür. Das Werkzeug springt n: Now the bathroom door. After each opening the tool jumps back to “Select” – so “Doors & windows” again, and tap the wall between hallway and bathroom.
Inside, it automatically becomes a room door. 80 centimetres wide is enough, and it should open into the bathroom: “Reverse opening direction”.
Beim Kontakt steht „Automatisch (keiner: The contact says “Automatic (none found)”. NeonPlan hands out an area's contacts one after another – and the hallway's door contact already belongs to the front door.
Also wähle ich von Hand: ins Feld klicke: So I pick it by hand: click the field, type “Bad”, choose “Bad Tür”. That works for every sensor – and “None”, „Keiner“, switches it off completely.
Hat ein Raum mehrere Türen, prüf die aut: So if a room has several doors, quickly check the automatic assignment. Now the bathroom door swings along too.
The bedroom gets a sliding door. “Style” lists every door style: room door, four front doors, glass door, sliding door and opening.
Vom Essbereich in die Küche geht eine Do: From the dining area into the kitchen there's a double door: tap the wall, “Double door” at the top – and “Glass door” as the style.
Bei zwei Flügeln heißen Knopf und Feld „: With two leaves, the button and the field are called “Main leaf”: they decide which leaf opens first. And each leaf can have its own contact.
Ohne Kontakt steht eine Tür in 3D halb o: Without a contact, a door stands half open in 3D – the hint at the bottom says so too. “Show closed without a sensor” draws it shut.
Bleibt der Durchbruch vom Flur ins Wohnz: That leaves the opening from the hallway into the living room. The tool remembers the last kind you picked – that's why it starts as a double door.
Ich klicke „Tür“ und wähle „Durchbruch“:: I click “Door” and choose “Opening (no door)”, „Durchbruch“: a gap without frame or door leaf, and light falls through it too.
Jetzt das Garagentor: „Tür & Fenster“, a: Now the garage door: “Doors & windows”, tap the front wall of the garage – and “Garage door” at the top.
Ein Tor hat keinen Stil und keinen Ansch: A gate has no style and no hinge. Under “Drive”, „Antrieb“, NeonPlan found the garage door in the garage area – it's at 60 percent right now.
Fährt das Tor, fährt es in 3D mit – der: When the door moves, it moves in 3D too – the open part lies under the ceiling. Instead of a drive, a garage door contact works as well.
„Positions-Sensor“ holt die Position aus: “Position sensor” takes the position from a separate sensor. And “Ask before switching”, „Vor dem Schalten nachfragen“, asks first before the door moves – good for tablets in the hallway.
Noch einmal zur Badtür. Unter „Markieren: Back to the bathroom door. “Highlight in 3D”, „Markieren in 3D“, is normally set to “When open”: open doors and windows glow warm.
„Wenn geschlossen“ dreht das um – prakti: “When closed” turns that around – handy for the toilet: the door glows as long as it's shut. For that it needs a contact.
When it opens, the glow is gone.
Passt alles, sperrst du den Grundriss ob: Once everything fits, lock the floor plan with “Floor plan” at the top, „Grundriss“: rooms, walls, doors and windows can no longer be moved by accident.
Ein Klick auf „Grundriss gesperrt“ oben: A click on “Floor plan locked” at the top of the form unlocks it again. And you delete with “Delete” at the bottom of the form, or with the Delete key.
Those were the doors and the garage door. Part 3 brings the windows: terrace door, glass wall, handle and tilt sensors, and blinds that move live.
Links zur Online-Demo und zur Anleitung: Links to the online demo and the manual are in the description. And NeonPlan runs on old wall tablets too. See you in a moment!
